newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia raises palm olein export tax.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia raises palm olein export tax.

text.p: Indonesia's export tax on RBD palm olein will be raised to $47.60 per tonne in September from $10.50 in August, the finance ministry said on Thursday.
The ministry said in a statement that tax on crude palm oil will be $34.16 per tonne, up from zero last month.
The export tax on RBD palm oil was raised to $33.04 per tonne from $3.00 in August, while that on crude olein was raised to $51.10 against $14.25.
The taxes, which were introduced in September 1994, are based on a composite average of international prices in the last two weeks of the previous month.
